items.t: Garmin Signal VHF named Overall Winner in 2026 DAME Design Awards
items.sum: Garmin (NYSE: GRMN), the world's largest1 and most innovative marine electronics manufacturer, today announced the Garmin Signal™ VHF series was selected as an Overall Winner of the prestigious 2026 DAME Design Awards. items.t: A December Rate Hike Looks Likely: Buy These 3 Low-Debt Dividend Stocks Before the Fed Moves
items.sum: Prediction markets say the Fed is almost certain to raise rates, and heavily indebted dividend payers will feel it first. Three companies hold up under higher borrowing costs, and one of them actually profits from the hike.
